did_you_know.text: Mount Nebo is generally identified with Jabal Nebo in Jordan, east of the Dead Sea. From this ridge, one can see across wide areas of the Land of Israel.
The word kikkar means a broad plain and here usually refers to the fertile area around Jericho. Jericho is called the “City of Palms” because date palms grew there abundantly.
Placing hands on Joshua was a public gesture of appointment and the transfer of authority. The Hebrew word semikhah, meaning ordination or authorization, comes from the same root.
The phrase “face to face” describes an especially direct and close relationship, not necessarily an ordinary physical meeting. It emphasizes the unique nature of Moses’ relationship with God.
